summary: Frontend-only mobile viewport (390x844) test of the Machinery iteration. ALL acceptance criteria PASS. (1) /machinery renders 3 summary tiles with correct counts (Machines=3, Due Soon=1, Overdue=1) and machines sorted overdue -> due -> good: Case 340 (Overdue, 5210h, '10h overdue'), Big Rig (Due Soon, 2380h, 'next @ 2400h'), Hardi Commander (Good, 1980h, 'next @ 2100h'). Cards show icon, name, make/model, hours, next-service or 'Xh overdue', and StatusBadge. (2) Tapping Case 340 opens /machinery/[id] view mode showing Year=2018, Serial=CI-M340-4472, Registration=AGRI-01/02, Current hours=5210, Purchase date=2018-08-01; Connected Data card with 'Manual hours' source + roadmap helper; Maintenance Schedule with amber warn-banner ('1 service due or overdue'); Transmission service card with '10h overdue' (red) + Mark Complete + trash buttons; Service History section with 'No completed services yet' empty state. (3) Pencil icon opens edit mode — all inputs prefilled (Case 340, Case IH, Magnum 340, 2018, AGRI-02, CI-M340-4472, 5210h) verified via screenshot. Machine type chips present incl. 'Self-propelled sprayer' & 'Tow-behind sprayer'. Selecting either sprayer chip immediately reveals the Sprayer setup card (edit-tank, edit-boom, edit-spacing, edit-positions, edit-def-nozzle, edit-def-speed, edit-def-water); switching back to Tractor hides it. Connected Data inputs (edit-ext-platform, edit-ext-machine-id) present with helper text. Save/Cancel/Delete buttons all present. (4) Mark Complete flow (the headline feature) works end-to-end: preseeded date=2026-09-07 (today), hours=5210 (machine.current_hours), work_performed='Transmission service' (maintenance_type), next_service_hours=6210 (5210+1000 interval). Editing hours to 5300 auto-recomputed next_service_hours to 6300 in real time. Saving created a MaintenanceCompletion (history-<uuid> card visible), rolled the parent Maintenance forward (last_service_hours=5300, last_service_date=2026-09-07, next_service_hours=6300), and bumped machine.current_hours from 5210 -> 5300 (since 5300 > 5210). Status badge flipped Overdue -> Good and '1000h remaining' displayed on the maintenance card. Service History header now shows '1 entry'. (5) /machinery/new works: type chips render, selecting sprayer reveals sprayer setup, Tractor hides it, TEST_Kubota created and app navigated to its detail. (6) + Add on detail opens /machinery/maintenance-new; filling maintenance_type/interval/last/next saves and returns to detail with the new maint-card visible. (7) Regression smoke check: Home ('/'), Spray, Chemicals, More tabs all load without red-screen or crashes after storage.ts change adding MaintenanceCompletion repo. No console errors observed. No deprecated Expo packages, no react-native issues detected in the reviewed files.
critical_code_review_comments: maintenance-complete.tsx recomputeNext correctly guards on !isNaN(h) and only recomputes when interval is known — matches spec.

maintenance-complete.tsx machinePatch only bumps machine.current_hours/km when the entered value is strictly greater than the current value — matches spec ('if hours entered exceed the machine's current_hours it bumps the machine value').
[id].tsx edit mode correctly toggles isSprayer clearing sprayer-only fields to undefined when non-sprayer type is chosen (lines 79-85), preventing stale sprayer data when a machine is reclassified.

[id].tsx nozzle_spacing_m is stored in metres in state but displayed/edited in mm — the round-trip conversion (*1000 on load, /1000 on save) is consistent between machinery/new.tsx and [id].tsx edit mode.

storage.ts maintenance_completions repo mirrors the maintenance repo shape (list/forMachine/forMaintenance/save/remove) — clean and consistent. Sorts forMachine by date desc which is what the detail screen expects.
seed.ts still uses seeded_v5 key — new MaintenanceCompletion collection starts empty for fresh users, expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of automated flows (11/11 acceptance criteria verified via UI; 2 native-Alert confirm dismissals verified by code inspection only — see caveat below)

seed_data_creation: During test on Case 340: (a) marked the Transmission service complete with hours=5300 -> created 1 MaintenanceCompletion row, updated Maintenance (last=5300, next=6300, last_service_date=2026-09-07), bumped machine.current_hours 5210 -> 5300. (b) briefly created TEST_Kubota + 'TEST_Oil filter' schedule; the delete flows use RN Alert.alert which Playwright could not dismiss in headless web, so those test rows may remain in AsyncStorage. Main agent may want to run repo.clearAll or hard-refresh the emulator before demoing to reset to pristine seed. The persistent Case 340 changes (5300h, next 6300, Good status, 1 history entry) will remain in AsyncStorage.

IMPORTANT: RN-web wraps TextInputs so `[data-testid=<id>] input` selectors return null; instead click the testID element and use page.keyboard.type. IMPORTANT: RN Alert.alert on web renders a custom in-page overlay (NOT window.confirm) — Playwright's `dialog` event does NOT fire for these; use text-based selector for the 'Delete' button inside the overlay to confirm, e.g. page.get_by_text('Delete', exact=True).nth(1).click(). AsyncStorage in this session now has: Case 340 current_hours=5300, its Transmission service maintenance next=6300 last=5300 last_service_date=2026-09-07, plus 1 MaintenanceCompletion row.
